name: Jira
description: Jira is Atlassian's issue and project tracker with REST APIs for cloud and Data Center.
auth_notes: Cloud REST uses basic auth with Atlassian account email and API token. Data Center also supports basic auth and an OAuth 2.0 provider via incoming application links.
gate_detail: Developers generate an API token from their own Atlassian account and use it with email via basic auth. REST API access is free on all Jira plans, so a Jira site is needed. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: REST APIs for Jira Cloud and Jira Data Center (Software), accessed via site URLs or api.atlassian.com with cloudId for scoped tokens.
mcp_notes: Atlassian Rovo MCP Server connects agents to Atlassian apps; supports OAuth 2.1 and API token authentication. URL not given in sources.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate for REST access; a Jira site is required and API token expiry applies.

evidence.quote: basic authentication with an Atlassian account email address
You generate the token from your Atlassian account, then copy and paste it into a script.
Access to the REST APIs is free for all Jira plans.
Register your application in Jira by creating an incoming link in application links.
The Atlassian Rovo MCP Server connects your AI agent to your Atlassian apps and work in a single conversation
